name: loom-memory
description: Use when you are about to write something to Loom, when the user states, decides or corrects a fact, and at the END of any substantial task before you report done. Decides what is durable memory versus scratchpad, how to write a fact so a future session can trust it, how to read what Loom hands back (persisted or not, conflict, abstain, verified or stale), and how to run the end-of-task memory review. NOT for code questions (loom-code), NOT for "is this already reported?" / duplicate or bisect checks (call loom_search or loom_tracker_duplicate_check directly — nothing to read first) and NOT for filing loom defects (improve-loom-for-my-repo).
